node: Takeout, delivery, coffee cup, cold beverage, and sustainable packaging
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for restaurant takeout, delivery, cups, cold beverage, and sustainable packaging. The cleanest underfollowed public exposure found in this pass is Karat Packaging, a small-cap disposable foodservice packaging supplier with meaningful restaurant/foodservice use and an eco-friendly product line. Graphic Packaging is a mid-cap reference/direct leader with explicit quick-service restaurant customers and cups, trays, and containers exposure. Sealed Air is a mid-cap second-order packaging platform for foodservice operators and QSR suppliers, especially sauces, condiments, proteins, dairy, liquid egg, and bag-in-box systems rather than consumer-facing takeout containers. Amcor is a large-cap reference after the Berry Global acquisition, relevant for scale and foodservice packaging but less pure and likely more followed. Pactiv Evergreen was excluded from candidates because it was acquired by Novolex and delisted from Nasdaq on April 1, 2025.
